name: cs2dm
description: CarbonStealth.eu | Dust2 DM — CS2 Deathmatch сървър само на Dust2: конфигурация, systemd, ъпдейти и проверка на здравето.

scripts.lint: for f in server/install.sh server/update.sh server/cs2dm-lib.sh server/mods/install-mods.sh server/mods/install-plugins.sh server/mods/mods-lib.sh server/mods/demos-clean.sh server/agent/install-agent.sh plugins/scripts/build.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server/a2s.mjs && node --check server/health.mjs && node --check server/mods/plugin-config.mjs && node --check server/agent/cs2-agent.mjs
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm test && node ../tools/vps/deploy-check.mjs server
